question:
In the following question, select the missing number from the given series.

51, 55, 64, 80, 105, ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

⇒ The squares of the consecutive numbers starting with 2 has been added to get the next term of the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2fae41ee4801bb97d6be3951a9c93a7f3113a3d640441c89d3f61f249c2ee8e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **" 141 "**.
